failure_policy: Preserve every failed or partial attempt. No automatic retries. Independent audit,retention and checked cleanup required before resolving qualification hold.
materialization: Windows retained primary and baseline with fresh locked checksum-verified dependencies and exact original compiler; Linux fresh pinned native preparation must bind original baseline or be rejected before calibration.
prior_exposure: All faults and ordinary contracts already exposed; repeated training correction,not new held-out selections.
recovery_method: Restore exact source and compile through normal approved offline Cargo rustc release recipe. Execute actual rebuilt image and preserve full bytes even when it differs from original. Original ordinary baseline reinstated only after observed recovery.
